linux-mainline-panther-lake on Omarchy

The bleeding-edge upstream kernel, built with Panther Lake audio support baked in.

Package data synced 2026-10-17 · generated from the official Omarchy package repo

Short answer

To install linux-mainline-panther-lake on Omarchy, open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add linux-mainline-panther-lake. It is a 152.9 MB download (152.9 MB installed), version 7.0rc4-2, licensed GPL-2.0-only. The Linux Mainline (Panther Lake audio support) kernel and modules. Free and open source.

On this page Install Open and use Requirements Uninstall Package facts Questions

Install linux-mainline-panther-lake on Omarchy

This package builds the Linux mainline kernel (the newest, still-in-development upstream branch tracked at kernel.org) with the audio driver work needed for Intel's Panther Lake laptop chips. It exists for people who want the very latest kernel changes rather than a stable release, on hardware new enough that its audio hasn't yet landed in a standard Arch kernel build.

  1. Open a terminal.
  2. Run the install command:
    omarchy pkg add linux-mainline-panther-lake
  3. Check it landed. Pacman should list version 7.0rc4-2:
    pacman -Qi linux-mainline-panther-lake

Open and use linux-mainline-panther-lake

linux-mainline-panther-lake has no window of its own: it is a command-line tool, library or system component. To see the commands it added to your PATH:

pacman -Ql linux-mainline-panther-lake | grep /usr/bin/

linux-mainline-panther-lake requirements and compatibility

  • An Intel Panther Lake-based laptop to benefit from the audio support
  • Comfort running an unstable/mainline kernel and its module headers

Dependencies Omarchy installs for you

  • coreutils
  • initramfs
  • kmod

Pricing and license

Free and open source. License: GPL-2.0-only.

Uninstall linux-mainline-panther-lake

omarchy pkg drop linux-mainline-panther-lake

Frequently asked questions

How do I install linux-mainline-panther-lake on Omarchy?

Open a terminal and run omarchy pkg add linux-mainline-panther-lake. The download is 152.9 MB and it takes 152.9 MB once installed. Omarchy pulls in any dependencies automatically.

Is linux-mainline-panther-lake free?

Free and open source. The package is licensed GPL-2.0-only.

How do I uninstall linux-mainline-panther-lake?

Run omarchy pkg drop linux-mainline-panther-lake. It removes the package from your system.

What does linux-mainline-panther-lake depend on?

The package declares 3 dependencies: coreutils, initramfs, kmod. Omarchy installs them for you.

Is linux-mainline-panther-lake a desktop app?

No. linux-mainline-panther-lake has no window of its own; it is a command-line tool, library or system component.

Is linux-mainline-panther-lake in the official Omarchy repo?

Yes. It is published as linux-mainline-panther-lake (version 7.0rc4-2) in the official Omarchy package repository. Linux kernel contributors makes it. Project site: https://kernel.org/.
